run_split_clean_cli: run the cleaner_splitter CLI module to split and clean sentences from tab-separated stdin input
create_SentenceSplitClean: create a SentenceSplitClean instance to split text into sentences and normalize with Moses and NFKC
use_reach_sentence_from_paragraph: use reach_sentence_from_paragraph to find a matching sentence by digest from a paragraph using candidate modifiers
use_get_sentence_candidate_modifiers: use get_sentence_candidate_modifiers to get a list of text transformation functions for sentence matching
use_remove_on_unicode_category: use remove_on_unicode_category to strip Unicode symbol characters from a string
